name: integration-eventbus-change-header-accessors-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: The fixture constructs and mutates Glade's synthetic eventbus.ChangeEventHeader value, while Salesforce exposes change headers through CDC events rather than this constructor/setter path; it receives zero Salesforce parity credit.

source.content: eventbus.ChangeEventHeader header = new eventbus.ChangeEventHeader(); header.setChangedFields(new List<String>{'Name', 'Amount'}); header.setChangeOrigin('integration-test'); header.setChangeType('UPDATE'); header.setCommitNumber(42L); header.setCommitTimestamp(1700000000123L); header.setCommitUser('005000000000001AAA'); header.setDiffFields(new List<String>{'Description', 'Amount'}); header.setEntityName('Account'); header.setNulledFields(new List<String>{'Phone'}); header.setRecordIds(new List<String>{'001000000000001AAA', '001000000000002AAA'}); header.setSequenceNumber(7); header.setTransactionKey('txn-42'); System.assertEquals('integration-test', header.getChangeOrigin()); System.assertEquals('UPDATE', header.getChangeType()); System.assertEquals(2, header.getChangedFields().size()); System.assertEquals(42L, header.getCommitNumber()); System.assertEquals(1700000000123L, header.getCommitTimestamp()); System.assertEquals('005000000000001AAA', header.getCommitUser()); System.assertEquals('Amount', header.getDiffFields()[1]); System.assertEquals('Account', header.getEntityName()); System.assertEquals('Phone', header.getNulledFields()[0]); System.assertEquals(2, header.getRecordIds().size()); System.assertEquals(7, header.getSequenceNumber()); System.assertEquals('txn-42', header.getTransactionKey()); System.assertEquals(true, header.equals(header)); System.assertNotEquals(null, header.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, header.toString());
